subject.title: fix(copilot): bound BYOK proxy request bodies

question: Should Copilot BYOK enforce a hard 16 MiB request-body cap and 30 second read timeout for existing BYOK proxy users?
rationale: The code shape is correct, but the cap changes an existing local provider proxy contract and automation cannot know the intended maximum legitimate BYOK request size.

options.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
options.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended Copilot BYOK request envelope now that normal forwarding and oversized rejection have proof and a test.

options.title: Tune the envelope before merge
options.body: Change the constants if maintainers expect legitimate BYOK SDK payloads above 16 MiB or reads longer than 30 seconds while keeping the shared-limiter shape.

options.title: Pause for payload confirmation
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers verify the expected BYOK SDK request-size envelope and timeout behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded proxy contract
recommendation.body: Treat 16 MiB and 30 seconds as the intended Copilot BYOK request envelope now that normal forwarding and oversized rejection have proof and a test.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the Copilot BYOK proxy and provider bridge, so they are the clearest available owner for the proxy request-envelope decision.
